# Callouts: Recovery 6 - reassembly: the cooker's cable back into J8

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec6-2_reassembly-j8.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec6-2_reassembly-j8.jpg)

All probes off. Lift J8's actuator, slide the cooker's own cable fully in and square, contacts facing the way they did before (see the 2026-11-04 bench photo), press the actuator down. Speaker back on J9.

| # | Ref | Identification | Part / marking | Category | Confidence | Notes |

| 1 | J8 | Actuator: lift to open, press down to lock |  | Connector | confirmed | The white flip actuator on the right of the 30-way FFC connector, with its end tabs. Lift it before the cable goes in, press it flat again once the cable sits square. |
| 2 | J8 pin 1 | Pin-1 end (circle) |  | Connector | likely | The printed circle at the lower end of the contact tails; '30' is printed at the other end. Pins 1-6 are the VIN group. |
